description: This file defines the CandidateMenuConfigurator class in the OrangeHRM Recruitment module. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface and customizes the menu configuration by overriding the screen to 'viewCandidates'.

classes.name: CandidateMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring the candidate menu in the recruitment module, overriding the default screen to 'viewCandidates'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the menu configuration to set the screen to 'viewCandidates'.
